At line 9: `decrypter = new AESDecrypter(localFileHeader, getAESSalt(raf), getAESPasswordVerifier(raf));`

These are two separate assignments to the same variable `decrypter`. The value of `decrypter` at line 9 is determined by the second assignment, which is independent of the value that `decrypter` had at line 8. The variable `decrypter` gets overwritten at line 9, so its value at line 9 is completely determined by the new assignment and does not depend on its previous value from line 8.
